# Awesome MCP Servers

> A curated list of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, clients, tools, frameworks and learning resources, maintained by MCP Playground. About 165 entries across 19 sections: official servers, developer tools, databases, messaging, productivity, finance, DevOps, search, files, e-commerce, CRM, media, security, AI/ML, testing and debugging, SDKs, learning resources, communities and directories. Remote servers on the list can be tested in the browser at mcpplaygroundonline.com.

## The list
- [README](https://github.com/MCPPlayground/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/readme.md): the full list, one line per entry with a link and description

## Sections
- [Official Servers](https://github.com/MCPPlayground/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/readme.md#official-servers): maintained by Anthropic or official project partners

## Test the servers
- [MCP Server Tester](https://mcpplaygroundonline.com/mcp-test-server): test any remote MCP server in the browser, no install
- [MCP Inspector Online](https://mcpplaygroundonline.com/mcp-inspector-online): browser alternative to npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector
- [MCP Agent Studio](https://mcpplaygroundonline.com/mcp-agent-studio): test MCP servers with 80+ AI models
- [MCP Playground Desktop](https://mcpplaygroundonline.com/local-mcp-server-testing): test local stdio and localhost MCP servers on macOS and Windows
